root_cause.text: The `xchk_quota_item` function in the XFS scrub subsystem fails to release the acquired dquot lock (`dq->q_qlock`) when returning early due to an error detected by `xchk_fblock_process_error`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that inside `xchk_quota_item`, a call to `mutex_unlock(&dq->q_qlock);` was added immediately before returning `error` when `!xchk_fblock_process_error(sc, XFS_DATA_FORK, offset, &error)` evaluates to true.
